pairs.notes: A uses setInterval(tick, 100) but decrements timeRemaining every call, making the countdown 10× too fast — a fatal timing bug; B is functionally correct with proper 1 s interval and adds a double-beep alert.
Both are feature-complete; A edges out on aesthetics with glow box-shadow on active mode, text-shadow on the timer digit, and uppercase button labels that feel more deliberate.
B's playAlert shares one gainNode between two oscillators, causing the second beep's envelope to conflict with the first's scheduled ramps; A's alert and all other features are clean.

A has richer polish (glow on buttons, text-shadow on timer) and correct layout; B places the mode selector below the timer (non-standard), uses height:100vh instead of min-height risking mobile clipping, and omits duration labels from mode buttons.
A merges Start and Pause into a single toggle button, violating the spec's requirement for separate Start and Pause controls; B implements all three buttons with correct disabled-state management.
B's mode buttons show only 'Focus' and 'Break' without the '(25:00)'/'(5:00)' duration labels the spec implies; A includes them and is otherwise comparably styled.

A implements proper button disabled-state toggling and a clean two-beep alert; B auto-switches modes on completion (unspecified behavior) and uses a 'Running…' label trick instead of button state management.

A's Reset button uses purple (#6e40aa) which contradicts the spec's single accent color, and mode buttons omit duration labels; B merges Start/Pause into one button violating the three-button requirement — both miss different parts of the spec.

B uses a single cycling mode button (ambiguous which mode is active at a glance), merges Start/Pause, and applies word-spacing:100vw which can cause layout artifacts; A has clean dual mode buttons and proper separate controls.

Both are feature-complete; B adds a subtle text-shadow glow on the timer digits, generous letter-spacing, box-shadow lift on button hover, and clean class-based architecture that produces a noticeably more polished result.
